description: AI news digest Sep 18: Claude 26 pct self-driven R and D, Arcee 1B Trinity open weights, Tencent Marvis, Edge0 35B on Mac mini.
lead: Models building models, standards for models, and models running where you live lead the last 24 hours. Anthropic quantified how much of its own research Claude now leads, the three largest labs confirmed weeks of joint safety work toward an industry testing body, and Arcee raised unicorn money to build American open weights. Mila and Mozilla launched a safe-by-design open initiative, Tencent let users plug any model into its assistant, and two memory-engineering results shrink flagship-class work onto consumer hardware. Every summary is in our own words; follow the links for the original reporting.
title: AI news digest — September 18, 2026: self-building models, open weights, and local runs
